name: hp-os
description: Harsh Pandey — premium full-stack portfolio with selected work, private content management, and a retrieval-backed AI assistant.

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @hp/shared && concurrently -k "npm run dev --workspace @hp/web" "npm run dev --workspace @hp/api"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build --workspace @hp/shared && npm run dev --workspace @hp/api
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @hp/shared && npm run build --workspace @hp/api && npm run build --workspace @hp/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace @hp/shared && npm run lint --workspace @hp/web && npm run lint --workspace @hp/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @hp/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @hp/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @hp/web
scripts.test: npm run test:web && npm run test:api
